decisions.reason: Despite its initial flagship role, two years without website presence after launch suggest results stayed below aspiration long enough that management would now reallocate resources to more promising reusable-packaging projects.

Although a multi-model line fits the core business, its disappearance from market-facing communication for 2020–2021 indicates weak enough performance or demand to justify withdrawal once the firm has had time to learn from the launch.
A less prominently featured crate line that is no longer observed after 2019 is likely judged below aspiration, and behavioral-theory logic points to exit after several years of uncertain results.

This pallet line was only lightly promoted even at launch, and two subsequent years without observation make it likely that management would discontinue it and redeploy capacity to stronger core products.

The spill-retention pallet had an identifiable niche, but prolonged absence from the website suggests the niche did not support performance at the level expected, reducing the case for continued support.

As a pallet variant leveraging existing capabilities, it may have received some tolerance initially, but by 2022 persistent non-observation implies enough shortfall versus aspirations to favor dropping it.
